rationale: Individually read prompt, starter, skeleton, four visible type tests, all visible/hidden calls, reference and criteria. Non-string dates incorrectly became null because text(nonstring) returned empty; fix the guard. Specify nonnegative safe integer ids and reject digit-string overflow/precision loss. Date validation is shape only, email deliberately only@ presence; missing date means unknown rather than proving no portal visit. Fixed field ordering can be deterministic; alphabetical order is this explicit contract. Add ordinary/frozen input, bounded strings and applicable On(totaltext) model. Seven final real grader verdicts include an independently written alternative and separate old/date/id/order wrongs; valid solutions retain base25 without false penalty.
